title: [Master] - Bug 648886: [Sustainability][Value Chain] Transfer Order uses average emissions instead of Specific carbon tracking (lot/serial)
summary: Sustainability posting now correctly tracks specific emissions for lots and serial numbers across transfer orders, preventing the use of average emissions on later sales.
key_points: Transfer order emissions tracking now respects specific lot and serial numbers instead of aggregating them
The transfer shipment application traversal is restricted to entries matching the same lot and serial number
Fixes cases where multiple tracked items with different emissions were incorrectly averaged during transfer receipts
Preserves specific tracking emissions through the entire supply chain from transfer to sale
quote: Restrict the recursive transfer-shipment application traversal to entries with the same Lot No. and Serial No.
